howto.name: Upload the PDF
howto.text: Select a standard PDF you want to convert into the PDF/A archival format.

howto.name: Choose the conformance level
howto.text: Select PDF/A-1b (basic), PDF/A-2b (supports transparency and JPEG2000), or PDF/A-3b (allows embedded files).

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. The tool embeds fonts, converts color spaces to sRGB, and validates compliance before returning the PDF/A file.

faq.q: What is PDF/A and why would I need it?
faq.a: PDF/A is an ISO-standardized archival format that ensures documents remain viewable long-term. Government agencies, courts, and archives often require PDF/A submissions.

faq.q: What changes does the conversion make?
faq.a: The tool embeds all fonts, converts color spaces to sRGB, removes JavaScript and multimedia, and adds the required PDF/A metadata.

faq.q: Will the document look different after conversion?
faq.a: Visually the document should look the same. Transparency may be flattened in PDF/A-1b, and embedded multimedia will be removed since PDF/A does not allow it.
